Puerta del Ángel — Madrid, Spain

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 131 areas reviewed individually Methodology →

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Several independent outlets report violent incidents in Puerta del Angel: a fatal stabbing of a young man in May 2023, an armed knifepoint-and-pistol robbery of a phone shop in December 2023 (at night), and a February 2024 report on a violent pickpocketing gang that had squatted premises and was intimidating residents. Real-estate and lifestyle sites, by contrast, ranked it among Madrid's calmer, more affordable barrios in 2025. Sources checked: Telemadrid, Feb 2024; Madridiario, May 2023; OKDiario, Dec 2023; Viviendajoven.com, 2025 (counter-source).

Frequently asked questions

Is Puerta del Ángel safe?

Wandroz currently rates Puerta del Ángel in Madrid as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Madrid at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Puerta del Ángel safe at night?

At night, Puerta del Ángel is rated as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Madrid. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Puerta del Ángel a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Puerta del Ángel's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
